annotations.description: The api target {{ $labels.instance }} has been down for 2 minutes: the web app, the CLI and the runners are without their API.
annotations.summary: API of cell {{ $labels.cell }} is not answering scrapes

annotations.description: Prometheus has no matelot-api target at all for 5 minutes: the metrics Service is gone or the ServiceMonitor is not selected (release label?).
No background work (sync, webhooks, correlation, policy evaluation, the sweeper) for 5 minutes; queued pipeline jobs of the evaluate stage do not run.
annotations.summary: Worker of cell {{ $labels.cell }} is not answering scrapes

annotations.description: Nobody can sign in and tokens cannot be refreshed; the API keeps serving already-issued tokens until they expire.

rules.name: MatelotNoRunnerOnline
rules.query: (sum by (cell) (matelot_runners_online) or sum by (cell) (matelot_pipeline_jobs_queued) * 0) == 0 and sum by (cell) (matelot_pipeline_jobs_queued) > 0

annotations.description: {{ $value }} pipeline job(s) wait for a runner and no runner has sent a heartbeat in the last minute, for 10 minutes.
annotations.summary: Cell {{ $labels.cell }}: jobs are queued and no runner is online

annotations.description: The oldest queued pipeline job (or BullMQ job) has waited {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}: too few runners, runners without the required tags, or a worker that stopped consuming.
annotations.summary: Cell {{ $labels.cell }}: the oldest queued job waits for more than 10 minutes

rules.name: MatelotPipelineFailureRate
rules.query: sum by (cell) (increase(matelot_pipelines_total{status="failed"}[1h])) / sum by (cell) (increase(matelot_pipelines_total[1h])) > 0.5 and sum by (cell) (increase(matelot_pipelines_total[1h])) >= 5

annotations.description: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of at least 5 pipelines failed in the last hour (a broken scanner image, a repository the runners cannot reach, a gate that fails every run).
annotations.summary: Cell {{ $labels.cell }}: more than half of the pipelines of the last hour failed

rules.name: MatelotDbConnectionsHigh
rules.query: sum by (cell, job) (db_client_connection_count{state="used"}) > 8 or sum by (cell, job) (db_client_connection_count{state="pending"}) > 0

annotations.description: More than 8 of the 10 pool connections in use, or callers waiting for one, for 10 minutes: a slow query holding connections or a load the replica count does not cover.
annotations.summary: Cell {{ $labels.cell }}: the {{ $labels.job }} Postgres pool is nearly exhausted

rules.name: MatelotBackupFailed
rules.query: max by (cell) (matelot_backup_last_failure_timestamp_seconds) > (max by (cell) (matelot_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds) or max by (cell) (matelot_backup_last_failure_timestamp_seconds) * 0)

annotations.description: The most recent backup run reported a failure (and no success since). The reason is in the API's backup reports and the backup Job's log.
The last successful backup is older than 36 hours: the schedule is off, runs fail, or backups are disabled while this rule is loaded.
annotations.summary: Cell {{ $labels.cell }}: no successful backup for {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}

annotations.description: Renew the licence key in Settings → License before it expires (the cell falls back to the Free tier).
annotations.summary: Cell {{ $labels.cell }}: the licence expires in {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}
